paper_specified.mft_objective: sum of full, detector_only, vlm_only focal losses
paper_specified.invalid_actions: masked using object-action compatibility during training

explicit_reconstruction_choices.clip_checkpoint: OpenAI ViT-L/14@336px; top three residual-block outputs before final pooling/projection; CLS excluded from spatial masks
explicit_reconstruction_choices.clip_resize: full augmented image resized to 336x336, not an untracked center crop
explicit_reconstruction_choices.icr_mask: Figure 3 interpreted as full query and multiplicatively masked key/value inputs
explicit_reconstruction_choices.rasterization: positive area patch overlap, preserving small boxes
explicit_reconstruction_choices.surrounding: union of other instance masks, retaining overlap pixels
explicit_reconstruction_choices.empty_surrounding: exact zero context and zero corresponding ProCA output
explicit_reconstruction_choices.norm_residual: post-norm residual attention/FFN, standard PyTorch Transformer conventions
explicit_reconstruction_choices.pair_mft_mask: zero disabled branch after linear/LN to suppress affine biases
explicit_reconstruction_choices.classifier: linear multi-label action-role logits for regular closed-set setting
explicit_reconstruction_choices.loss_normalization: matched positive edges, shared across MFT configurations
explicit_reconstruction_choices.training_detector_prior: not multiplied into train logits; detection confidence added at inference only
explicit_reconstruction_choices.vcoco_backend: visible native-24 action roles, excludes agent-only and point; not claimed as author-confirmed null convention
explicit_reconstruction_choices.matching: both boxes IoU >= 0.5 AND predicted object class matches annotated object class
explicit_reconstruction_choices.augmentation_order: shared horizontal flip and color jitter; short-side resize; optional square crop 384-600 clipped to actual shorter side (including panoramas below 384 after long-side capping); resize again
explicit_reconstruction_choices.distributed_layout: eight GPUs at microbatch two rather than author four GPUs at microbatch four
explicit_reconstruction_choices.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch 30; no intermediate test selection
